## Reproducibility checklist

- [ ] Every new headline number resolves to a named script and a stored result file.
- [ ] No model, threshold, or rule is fitted on evaluation prompts (splits are disjoint).
- [ ] Paired comparisons report prompt-paired bootstrap CIs.
- [ ] Negative results are preserved, not edited out.
- [ ] The claim-to-artifact audit passes (`python scripts/e9_claim_audit.py`).
- [ ] No secrets are committed.
